messages:
jamal: Heads-up — started a BMC OTA (microcode+hwmon) in eu-west-2 GPU racks (batch 7). After ~10% of the batch went live, we saw serial console stalls and short IPMI session drops. Affected nodes briefly go to provisioning hold. Impact: ~18 nodes, about 2% of eu-west-2 GPU capacity.

sasha: :eyes: any error logs from the BMC during the drop? kernel vs firmware?

jamal: Ops bot captured the initial alerts, here's the tail from one host:```
[2026-03-18T10:12:07Z] bmc-fw: initiating ota apply
[2026-03-18T10:12:23Z] bmc-ipmi: session-42 closed (reason=timeout)
[2026-03-18T10:12:23Z] serial-mux: tx queue stall
[2026-03-18T10:12:24Z] bmc-fw: apply complete, rebooting mgmt-plane
[2026-03-18T10:12:55Z] bmc-ipmi: session-restore success
```

maria: hmm, serial-mux tx queue stall looks like the BMC watchdog doesn't yield during the early reboot. Could be MCU power gating changes in new microcode. Did we flip secure-boot or efi lockdown flags in this push?

jamal: Not intentionally. The package includes a signed microcode blob but no secure boot attr toggles. But I did notice the apply path writes NVRAM flags: `bmc.apply_state=1` then clears it after reboot. Might be corruption race causing serial driver to block.

kevin: For immediate mitigation we should: 1) pause the rollout, 2) disable automatic provisioning hold in the deployer for eu-west-2, 3) run a targeted rollback to previous BMC image for the 18 nodes. Anyone object?

ops-bot: Deploy pause: acknowledged. Rollout paused at 10% across eu-west-2.

sasha: Agree with rollback. Also propose a hotfix runbook: a) IPMI power-cycle (ipmitool chassis power cycle) if console unresponsive, b) clear bmc.apply_state via `nvram-tool` after IPMI comes back, c) re-run health-check probe. I'll draft steps.

maria: If we need broader mitigation, we can instead throttle OTA concurrency and add a 90s post-apply probe to ensure serial resumes before marking node healthy. That reduces blast radius and cost of failed reprovisions.

jamal: I'll coordinate rollback for the 18 nodes now. Notifying oncall to avoid auto-reprovision churn. I'll attach node list in a follow-up. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

kevin: Please add an entry to the firmware release notes: "Observed serial-mux stall on some BMC platforms; do not enable concurrent provisioning holds; use 90s post-apply probe." We'll also run a longer soak in staging with same power characteristics before retry.

sasha: I'll add a short test in CI that flips the nvram flag and simulates reboot so we catch this next time.

jamal: update: rollback started (jobs enqueued). will post node list + job IDs in ~5m. ops-bot will track progress.
